thread.subject: CRM licence
thread.body: Hi team, please assign a full Sales Cloud licence to me - I need to build the new territory dashboards before the QBR at the end of the month. My current seat is the old 'Platform' one, which can't create reports, and I've been stuck on this for a week already. Thanks, Marcus Bell, Sales Operations

thread.subject: RE: CRM licence
thread.body: Hi Marcus, I checked the licence console and you already hold a Sales Full seat (SEAT-2291), assigned in March when you moved into Sales Ops; the Platform seat you mention was removed at that point. Could you confirm which user is actually missing access? If you're seeing a 'cannot create report' message, it may be a folder permission rather than a licence.

thread.subject: RE: RE: CRM licence
thread.body: Ah sorry, you're right, I was going off an old screenshot. It's actually for Leila Haddad, who joined my team from the Lisbon office last week. She'll be doing a lot of the territory work with me. She can't see any reports today, just a blank Reports tab.

thread.subject: RE: RE: RE: CRM licence
thread.body: Hi all, thanks for looking at this. Just to clarify what I need: I only have to view the territory dashboards and export them into the QBR slides. Marcus builds and edits the reports himself. I don't need to create or edit opportunities or accounts.

thread.subject: RE: RE: RE: RE: CRM licence
thread.body: Fair point, Leila. In that case a viewer seat is fine for now, we can revisit after the QBR. Let's not burn a full licence, finance is watching CRM spend closely this quarter. Consider this my approval.

licence_policy.LIC-4.1: Full seats (Sales Full) are assigned only to users who create or edit opportunities, accounts or reports.
licence_policy.LIC-4.2: Users who only view and export dashboards receive an Analytics Viewer seat.
licence_policy.LIC-4.3: A licence request for another person must be approved by that person's line manager; the service desk checks the manager in the HR directory.
licence_policy.LIC-4.4: Full seats reclaimed from leavers are reassigned first, before new full seats are purchased.
licence_policy.LIC-4.5: Seats cannot be shared or rotated between users.

Hi IT,

Sorry to lump these together, I know you prefer one ticket per issue but I've been meaning to write for ages and this is the first quiet morning I've had.

First, the VPN was really slow last week when I was working from my parents' place, pages took forever to load, but it seems OK now so ignore that unless someone else mentions it. Second, the printer on 3 keeps asking me to 'select a tray' every time I print double-sided - I've just been printing single-sided, which is fine honestly. The thing I actually need help with today: I changed banks last month and I need to update my bank details for salary in the HR portal. I haven't given my bank details to anyone else and I don't want anyone to change them for me - I just want to do it myself like everyone else. If it's easier, I'm happy to jump on a call, I'm at my desk all afternoon apart from a 2pm meeting. My extension is below and I'm also on chat.

Thanks so much and sorry again for the essay,
Priya Nair

state.policy: SD-PW-02 rev.4 - Phone resets. (a) Standard accounts: verify two of three factors - employee ID; the name of the caller's CURRENT line manager; last four digits of the mobile number on file. A factor counts only if the caller's final answer matches the record. (b) Privileged accounts (Tier-0, Finance-Approver): all three factors plus callback. root_cause_home.instructions: Is the user's home network, rather than the company VPN service, the more likely cause of the afternoon drops?

repeat_contact.instructions: Do `history` and `ticket_text` together show the same issue being raised before?

handling.instructions: What is the most appropriate next step for this ticket?

criteria.escalate_to_vpn_l2: Escalate to second-line VPN support with the history

frustration.note: Capitals, 'some genius', and 'just pasting the same script' are sarcastic insults at the service, but there is no threat or slur.

pause_allowed.note: CC-2 excludes frustration, sarcasm and criticism of the service. 'Some genius' is not aimed at a named person, though a few agents would treat it as a personal insult.

root_cause_home.note: Afternoon-only drops that survive a router restart could be home broadband congestion or a VPN-side session timeout. No diagnostics are in the state.

repeat_contact.note: The ticket says 'THIRD time', and history shows two earlier router-restart closures. The history doesn't restate the VPN topic, but the matching resolution implies it.

handling.note: Two closures without confirmation using the same script mean the issue needs second-line investigation.

state: Hi, a file I need is gone from the Projects share. It was called something like 'budget final v3' or maybe 'budget final FINAL', can't remember which. I think I deleted it by accident sometime in the spring when I was tidying up? Can you get it back from a backup? Thanks - Owen (Estates)

file_name.instructions: Which file name does the message give for the missing file?

criteria.unclear_between_candidates: The sender offers both names and is unsure

deletion_month.instructions: Which month does the message name for the deletion?

full_path.instructions: Does the message give the full folder path of the file?

self_deleted.instructions: Does the sender say he deleted the file himself?

actionability.instructions: How actionable is this restore request as written?

criteria.definition: Approximate name and location, no usable date
Name, location and an approximate date
Exact path, name and deletion date

file_name.note: He offers two names and 'can't remember which'.

deletion_month.note: Only a season ('spring') is given, not a month.

self_deleted.note: 'I think I deleted it by accident' is a hedged self-attribution with a question mark, so it is not a firm statement.

actionability.note: There is an approximate name and share, plus 'sometime in the spring'. Whether a season counts as an approximate date splits reviewers.

alert.message: TLS certificate for api-int.example.com expires in 6 days
alert.requested_change: Renewal request from the owning team adds SAN api-int-v2.example.com

state.cert_process: CP-1 Certificates are renewed via standard change SC-031 only when the CN and SANs are unchanged. CP-2 Any change to the CN or SANs needs a normal change with a security review. CP-3 Production certificate alerts with less than 7 days remaining page the owning team out of hours; non-production alerts go to the team queue.

environment.instructions: Which environment does `cmdb` record for the certificate host in `alert.message`?

pages_out_of_hours.instructions: Under `cert_process`, does this alert page the owning team out of hours?

instructions.question: Which kind of change does the renewal in `alert.requested_change` need?
instructions.process_rule: CP-1: standard change SC-031 only when CN and SANs are unchanged. CP-2: any CN or SAN change needs a normal change with a security review.

owner.instructions: Which team does `cmdb` list as owner of the certificate host?

san_reason_stated.instructions: Does the state explain why the extra SAN is being added?

exposure.instructions: How serious would it be if this certificate lapsed?

environment.note: api-int.example.com is Staging; api.example.com (Production) is a near-name distractor.

pages_out_of_hours.note: CP-3 pages only for production certificates; this host is Staging, so it goes to the team queue.

change_type.note: Adding a SAN changes the SANs, so CP-2 applies rather than SC-031.

owner.note: The CMDB owner_team is Platform Integration.

san_reason_stated.note: The SAN addition is noted without any reason.

exposure.note: A staging API interruption mostly hits test traffic, but an 'api-int' host may serve internal integrations. The state doesn't say, so levels 1 and 2 are both plausible.
